youtube.title: This mayor's 4.5-foot beard killed him 💀 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Hans Steininger had the longest beard in town. It did NOT end well 💀

Beard or your life? Pick one 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history (legend says): Hans Steininger, mayor of Braunau am Inn, had a beard about 4.5 feet (1.4 m) long that he usually kept rolled up in a leather pouch. In September 1567 a fire broke out; legend says he ran without rolling it up, stepped on it and broke his neck. His beard is still kept in the town's district museum.
